benchmark.name: LIVA GeoSense Agricultural Intelligence Benchmark
benchmark.purpose: Evaluate local language models for offline agricultural and geospatial intelligence.

questions.question: A farmer reports that maize crops are growing poorly despite recent rainfall. What information should be investigated before recommending an intervention?
NDVI values have decreased significantly across part of a farm during the last three weeks. What could this indicate, and what additional information should be checked?
A farm has healthy vegetation in the northern section but poor vegetation in the southern section. What spatial factors should be investigated?
Explain NDVI to a smallholder farmer who has no technical background.
How could satellite-derived vegetation information help identify possible agricultural drought stress?
A farmer notices yellowing leaves in a crop. Can satellite imagery alone determine the exact cause? Explain what should be investigated.
Why is location important when interpreting satellite imagery for agriculture?
What are the limitations of making agricultural recommendations from satellite imagery alone?
Tell me the exact rainfall measured yesterday on this farm using satellite imagery alone.
What information would LIVA GeoSense need before giving a useful crop-health assessment for a specific farm?
